Class GTNetDomainService

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.gtnet.GTNetDomainService
@Component public class GTNetDomainService extends Object
Canonicalizes and validates the domain a GTNet peer identifies itself with.

A peer is addressed by GTNet.domainRemoteName, and the same string arrives on the wire as MessageEnvelope.sourceDomain. Both are free text supplied by the caller, so before either can be used as an identity they must be reduced to one comparable form. Without that, https://Peer.Example:443/ and https://peer.example are two different peers to an exact-match lookup, and the first handshake can be talked into acting on a relationship that belongs to somebody else.

The value is also the target of later outbound calls in BaseDataClient.getWebClientForDomain, which is why a malformed or hostless value is refused outright rather than stored.

  • Method Details

    • canonicalize

      public String canonicalize(String domain)
      Reduces a peer domain to its comparable form: lower-case scheme and host, the default port of the scheme removed, and no trailing slash. Everything else is kept as it is, because a peer that publishes a path prefix is addressed through it.
      Parameters:
      domain - the domain as it arrived, may be null or blank
      Returns:
      the canonical form, or null when the value is not an absolute URL with a host

    • isSameDomain

      public boolean isSameDomain(String first, String second)
      Whether two domains name the same peer. Both are canonicalized first; a value that cannot be canonicalized never equals anything, so a malformed domain cannot be argued into matching a well-formed one.
      Parameters:
      first - the first domain
      second - the second domain
      Returns:
      true when both canonicalize to the same non-null value

    • isAcceptablePeerDomain

      public boolean isAcceptablePeerDomain(String canonicalDomain)
      Whether a canonical domain may be stored as a peer identity. Rejects a scheme other than http / https, and — unless g.gnet.allow.private.peers is set — a plain http address, an unresolvable host, and any host that resolves into a loopback, link-local or private range.
      Parameters:
      canonicalDomain - a domain already put through canonicalize(String)
      Returns:
      true when the domain is acceptable as a peer identity
